name: Pullover
author: Mishkin Faustini
description: An unofficial Pushover Open Client for Omarchy, not released or supported by Pushover. Native desktop notifications, a bar widget with unread count and history, and sign-in from the panel.

barWidget.description: Pushover messages as native notifications, with unread count, recent history and emergency acknowledgement.
